workflows.title: Build a website or web app

stages.outcome: Identify the audience, primary action, pages, content, and acceptance criteria. For a personal site, use a short brief.
stages.check: The brief covers the requested content and states any material assumption.

stages.outcome: Set a visual direction from the audience, real content, and references. Define typography, layout, and mobile behavior.
stages.check: Review a representative screen for hierarchy, readability, responsive layout, and consistency.

stages.outcome: Use the existing stack when there is one. Build the smallest complete user flow first.
stages.check: Run the project build and verify the primary flow with realistic content.

stages.outcome: Exercise the primary flow in a browser at desktop and mobile widths.
stages.check: Verify navigation, keyboard use, visible focus, and any forms. Record what was observed.

stages.outcome: Capture the user outcome, constraints, scope, and acceptance criteria.
stages.check: Resolve decisions that would materially alter the plan. Record the rest as assumptions.

stages.outcome: Split the work into deliverable slices and identify dependencies, risks, and verification for each slice.
stages.check: Each slice has a testable result and a clear dependency order.

stages.outcome: Use audience, content, and existing brand to choose a visual direction. Apply it to the requested surface.
stages.check: Inspect hierarchy and layout with representative content, including narrow screens.

stages.outcome: Review semantics, focus, contrast, and interaction states.
stages.check: Test keyboard navigation and responsive behavior. Check reduced motion when animation is present.

stages.outcome: Read project rules, inspect the feature boundary and callers, and identify the smallest viable change.
stages.check: Confirm affected behavior and concrete acceptance criteria before editing.

stages.outcome: Use the existing stack and patterns. Make a focused change and add a meaningful test where behavior warrants it.
stages.check: Exercise normal, error, and relevant edge cases using the project's existing checks.

stages.outcome: Run the checks affected by the change and inspect the diff against requirements.
stages.check: Report actual command results and any unresolved limitation.

stages.outcome: Reproduce the failure. Trace evidence to the root cause before making changes.
stages.check: Capture a failing reproduction or give the exact reason reproduction is unavailable.

stages.outcome: Apply the smallest correction and re-run the reproduction plus affected checks.
stages.check: Show that the original failure now passes and report any remaining uncertainty.

stages.outcome: Map the relevant boundaries, constraints, and dependencies. Compare viable structures against the requested change.
stages.check: Record the decision and the consequences for callers, testing, and migrations.

workflows.title: Design or test an API or data model

stages.outcome: Inspect data ownership, contracts, and existing clients. Define validation, errors, and compatibility.
stages.check: Tie each public behavior to a contract example. Include failure cases and migration impact.

stages.outcome: Use the project's contract, integration, and migration checks to verify the requested change.
stages.check: Exercise success, rejected input, and compatibility cases relevant to the change.

workflows.title: Build or improve a mobile app

stages.outcome: Identify the primary mobile flow, target platforms, and the current stack.
stages.check: Confirm the main flows and platform-specific constraints.

stages.outcome: Implement the smallest usable slice with navigation, loading, and recovery states as needed.
stages.check: Run the project checks and exercise the main flow on a supported simulator or device.

stages.outcome: Review the actual diff against its requirements and trace affected callers.
stages.check: Give actionable findings with evidence and scope. State which checks ran.

stages.outcome: Read the current behavior and docs. Give the intended reader enough information to do the task.
stages.check: Verify commands, examples, paths, and claims against the current project.

stages.outcome: Collect a baseline on a representative workload and identify the dominant cost.
stages.check: Compare before and after under the same conditions and check for regressions.

workflows.title: Verify a web flow in a browser

stages.outcome: Run the requested flow in an available browser with representative data.
stages.check: Report the observed result and distinguish manual behavior, automated coverage, and environment limits.

stages.outcome: Identify the target, build and test commands, environment requirements, migration order, and rollback procedure.
stages.check: Verify the candidate in preview or staging and collect the relevant smoke check results.

workflows.title: Deploy and verify an authorized release

stages.outcome: Use the project's approved delivery flow. Check runtime health after an authorized deployment.
stages.check: Confirm the deployed revision, primary flow, health signals, and rollback trigger. Report whether deployment actually took place.

stages.outcome: Add focused tests using the project’s existing test framework and a representative failure case.
stages.check: Run the affected tests and record the result.
